The author is frank to admit the hair-raising quality of them. Indeed, they have tickled his own scalp. Well, it is proper that the hair of the reader should sometimes stand on end and his eyes pop wide.

arxiv-1810-04236.title: Sparsity-Based Kalman Filters for Data Assimilation Thanks: This work was supported in part by U.S. Naval Research Laboratory - Monterey, CA
arxiv-1810-04236.creator: Wei Kang, Liang Xu
arxiv-1810-04236.description: Abstract Several variations of the Kalman filter algorithm, such as the extended Kalman filter (EKF) and the unscented Kalman filter (UKF), are widely used in science and engineering applications. In this paper, we introduce two algorithms of sparsity-based Kalman filters, namely the sparse UKF and the progressive EKF. The filters are designed specifically for problems with very high dimensions.

arxiv-2112-06434.title: Scalable subsampling: computation, aggregation and inference
arxiv-2112-06434.creator: Dimitris N. Politis
arxiv-2112-06434.description: Abstract Subsampling is a general statistical method developed in the 1990s aimed at estimating the sampling distribution of a statistic θ ^ n \hat{\theta}_{n} in order to conduct nonparametric inference such as the construction of confidence intervals and hypothesis tests.

arxiv-2204-13290.title: On the Normalizing Constant of the Continuous Categorical Distribution
arxiv-2204-13290.creator: Elliott Gordon-Rodriguez, Gabriel Loaiza-Ganem, Andres Potapczynski, John P. Cunningham
arxiv-2204-13290.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Elliott Gordon-Rodriguez, Gabriel Loaiza-Ganem, Andres Potapczynski, John P. Cunningham. Probability distributions supported on the simplex enjoy a wide range of applications across statistics and machine learning. Recently, a novel family of such distributions has been discovered: the continuous categorical . This family enjoys remarkable mathematical simplicity; its density function resembles that of the Dirichlet distribution, but with a normalizing constant that can be written in closed form using elementary functions only.

arxiv-2210-10689.title: Towards Procedural Fairness: Uncovering Biases in How a Toxic Language Classifier Uses Sentiment Information
arxiv-2210-10689.creator: Isar Nejadgholi, Esma Balkır, Kathleen C. Fraser, Svetlana Kiritchenko
arxiv-2210-10689.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Isar Nejadgholi, Esma Balkır, Kathleen C. Fraser, Svetlana Kiritchenko. Previous works on the fairness of toxic language classifiers compare the output of models with different identity terms as input features but do not consider the impact of other important concepts present in the context. Here, besides identity terms, we take into account high-level latent features learned by the classifier and investigate the interaction between these features and identity terms.

arxiv-2211-16945.title: Federated Learning-Based Cell-Free Massive MIMO System for Privacy-Preserving
arxiv-2211-16945.creator: Jiayi Zhang, Jing Zhang, Derrick Wing Kwan Ng, Bo Ai
arxiv-2211-16945.description: Abstract Cell-free massive MIMO (CF mMIMO) is a promising next generation wireless architecture to realize federated learning (FL). However, sensitive information of user equipments (UEs) may be exposed to the involved access points or the central processing unit in practice. To guarantee data privacy, effective privacy-preserving mechanisms are defined in this paper.

arxiv-2307-09233.title: Distilling Knowledge from Text-to-Image Generative Models Improves Visio-Linguistic Reasoning in CLIP
arxiv-2307-09233.creator: Samyadeep Basu, Shell Xu Hu, Maziar Sanjabi, Daniela Massiceti, Soheil Feizi
arxiv-2307-09233.description: Abstract Image-text contrastive models like CLIP have wide applications in zero-shot classification, image-text retrieval, and transfer learning. However, they often struggle on compositional visio-linguistic tasks (e.g., attribute-binding or object-relationships) where their performance is no better than random chance. To address this, we introduce SDS-CLIP, a lightweight and sample-efficient distillation method to enhance CLIP’s compositional visio-linguistic reasoning.

arxiv-2401-08572.title: The Illusion of Artificial Inclusion DOI: 10.1145/3613904.3642703 Conference: Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; May 11–16, 2024; Honolulu, HI, USA Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’24), May 11–16, 2024, Honolulu, HI,
arxiv-2401-08572.creator: William Agnew, A. Stevie Bergman, Jennifer Chien, Mark Díaz, Seliem El-Sayed, Jaylen Pittman, Shakir Mohamed, Kevin R. McKee
arxiv-2401-08572.description: Abstract . Human participants play a central role in the development of modern artificial intelligence (AI) technology, in psychological science, and in user research. Recent advances in generative AI have attracted growing interest to the possibility of replacing human participants in these domains with AI surrogates.

arxiv-2402-17294.title: Advancing Continuous Distribution Generation: An Exponentiated Odds Ratio Generator Approach
arxiv-2402-17294.creator: Xinyu Chen, Yuanqi Xie, Achraf Cohen, Shusen Pu
arxiv-2402-17294.description: Abstract This paper presents a new methodology for generating continuous statistical distributions, integrating the exponentiated odds ratio within the framework of survival analysis. This new method enhances the flexibility and adaptability of distribution models to effectively address the complexities inherent in contemporary datasets.

arxiv-2406-09363.title: Elicitation GPT \text{Elicitation}^{\text{GPT}} : Text Elicitation Mechanisms via Language Models
arxiv-2406-09363.creator: Yifan Wu, Jason Hartline
arxiv-2406-09363.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yifan Wu, Jason Hartline. Scoring rules evaluate probabilistic forecasts of an unknown state against the realized state and are a fundamental building block in the incentivized elicitation of information. This paper develops mechanisms for scoring elicited text against ground truth text by reducing the textual information elicitation problem to a forecast elicitation problem, via domain-knowledge-free queries to a large language model (specifically ChatGPT), and empirically evaluates their alignment with human preferences.

arxiv-2406-12280.title: Uncertainty relations based on state-dependent norm of commutator
arxiv-2406-12280.creator: Aina Mayumi, Gen Kimura, Hiromichi Ohno, Dariusz Chruściński
arxiv-2406-12280.description: Abstract We introduce two uncertainty relations based on the state-dependent norm of commutators, utilizing generalizations of the Böttcher-Wenzel inequality. The first relation is mathematically proven, while the second, tighter relation is strongly supported by numerical evidence. Both relations surpass the conventional Robertson and Schrödinger bounds, particularly as the quantum state becomes increasingly mixed.

arxiv-2410-16623.title: MotionGlot: A Multi-Embodied Motion Generation Model https://ivl.cs.brown.edu/research/motionglot.html
arxiv-2410-16623.creator: Sudarshan Harithas, Srinath Sridhar
arxiv-2410-16623.description: Abstract This paper introduces MotionGlot, a model that can generate motion across multiple embodiments with different action dimensions, such as quadruped robots and human bodies. By leveraging the well-established training procedures commonly used in large language models (LLMs), we introduce an instruction-tuning template specifically designed for motion-related tasks.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-scala-sancta-.creator: Livarius Oliger
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-scala-sancta-.description: Article 'Scala Sancta (Holy Stairs)' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-10663257.title: Emerging trends and hot spots of sleep and genetic research: a bibliometric analysis of publications from 2002 to 2022 in the field
pmc-10663257.creator: Ying Tao, Yi Qin, Sifan Chen, Tian Xu, Junhui Lin, Diansan Su, Weifeng Yu, Xuemei Chen
pmc-10663257.description: BackgroundSleep is an important biological process and has been linked to many diseases; however, very little is known about which and how genes control and regulate sleep. Although technology has seen significant development, this issue has still not been adequately resolved.

pmc-10670907.title: Uncertainty and the NICU Experience: A Qualitative Evaluation of Family and Provider Perspectives
pmc-10670907.creator: Katharine Griffin Gorsky, Saloni Butala, Madison House, Chelsea Moon, Sam Calvetti, Tenzin Khando, Michele Kipke, Ashwini Lakshmanan
pmc-10670907.description: There is limited information regarding caregiver and provider perspectives on uncertainty across the continuum of the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) experience. Open-ended semi-structured interviews were conducted with providers and English- and Spanish-speaking caregivers of infants with a history of admission to a quaternary safety-net NICU. Major themes were generated using inductive–deductive thematic analysis.

pmc-11434517.title: Resin Acid Copper Salt, an Interesting Chemical Pesticide, Controls Rice Bacterial Leaf Blight by Regulating Bacterial Biofilm, Motility, and Extracellular Enzymes
pmc-11434517.creator: Lihong Shi, Xiang Zhou, Puying Qi, Chengxia Tan
pmc-11434517.description: Bacterial virulence plays an important role in infection. Antibacterial virulence factors are effective for preventing crop bacterial diseases. Resin acid copper salt as an effective inhibitor exhibited excellent anti-Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae (Xoo) activity with an EC50 of 50.0 μg mL−1. Resin acid copper salt (RACS) can reduce extracellular polysaccharides’ (EPS’s) biosynthesis by down-regulating gumB relative expression.

pmc-11512987.title: Multifunctional extracellular vesicles and edaravone-loaded scaffolds for kidney tissue regeneration by activating GDNF/RET pathway
pmc-11512987.creator: Seung Yeon Lee, Jeong Min Park, Won-Kyu Rhim, Eun Hye Lee, Sang-Hyuk Lee, Jun Yong Kim, Seung-Gyu Cha, Sun Hong Lee, Boram Kim, Dong-Youn Hwang, Seungsoo Rho, Tae-Keun Ahn, Bum Soo Kim, Dong Keun Han
pmc-11512987.description: With the severity of chronic kidney disease worldwide, strategies to recover renal function via tissue regeneration provide alternatives to kidney replacement therapy. To exclude side effects from direct cell transplantation, extracellular vesicles (EVs) are great substitutes representing paracrine cell signaling.

pmc-11804208.title: Research progress and perspectives on the application of tyramide signal amplification-based multiplex immunohistochemistry/immunofluorescence: a bibliometrics analysis
pmc-11804208.creator: Xiaotong Yu, Chen Huang, Yan Song, Chun Zhang, Debo You, XuRan Dong, DeFu Wu, Alan Keith Meeker, Hao Feng, Yuqing Wang
pmc-11804208.description: Background and aimsMultiplex immunohistochemistry/immunofluorescence (mIHC/IF), which uses the tyramide signal amplification (TSA) technique, enables sequential staining of multiple targets in formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) samples without worrying about cross-reactivity. This approach has received considerable attention from researchers over the past decades. This article aims to provide a bibliometric analysis of the research progress and perspectives on the application of TSA-based mIHC/IF.

pmc-12617450.title: Benediction sign in a patient with intramedullary tumor and syringomyelia
pmc-12617450.creator: Nomena Finiavana Rasaholiarison, Haja Parany Rabearisoa
pmc-12617450.description: e motor deficits and sensory loss in her 4 limbs. It began with a sensory loss of the right upper and lower limbs, followed by a motor deficit in the right lower limb, left lower limb, and left upper limb. This was painless with a flexion contracture of the fourth and fifth left fingers.

pmc-12655405.title: The Effects of Frondanol, a Non-Polar Extract of the Atlantic Sea Cucumber, in Colon Cancer Cells
pmc-12655405.creator: Hardik Ghelani, Hala Altaher, Hadil Sarsour, Marah Tabbal, Sally Badawi, Thomas E Adrian, Reem K Jan, Heriberto Torres-Moreno, Julio César López-Romero, Elena Y Enioutina, Max Vidal Gutiérrez
pmc-12655405.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the second leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. The search for effective, new antineoplastic drugs with fewer side effects for the treatment of CRC continues, with marine-derived compounds emerging as promising candidates. Objectives: This study investigates the anticancer potential of Frondanol, a nutraceutical derived from the Atlantic Sea cucumber Cucumaria frondosa, known for its potent anti-inflammatory properties.

pmc-13364883.title: Impact of severe varus deformity on the outcome of mobile-bearing unicompartmental knee arthroplasty: a comparison of patients with varus deformity of less than and more than 15 degrees using matched-pair analysis
pmc-13364883.creator: Arun B. Mullaji, Anand Kumar Gupta, George K. George, Rufiat Kazi
pmc-13364883.description: IntroductionThe outcome of patients undergoing UKA with larger preoperative deformity (> 15º varus) and lesser deformity is sparsely compared in the literature. This matched-pair retrospective study attempts to fill this research gap by comparing the effect of preoperative and postoperative residual varus on outcome.

pmc-13578527.title: Feasibility and Reproducibility of a Structure‐Guided Deep Learning Model for Automatic Detection of the Standard Sagittal Plane in First‐Trimester Nuchal Translucency Assessment Using 3D Ultrasound
pmc-13578527.creator: Hayan Kwon, Hyewon Hur, Hyun Cheol Cho, Yun ji Jung, Suhra Kim, Ja‐Young Kwon
pmc-13578527.description: ObjectivesAccurate nuchal translucency (NT) measurement for assessing the risk of fetal genetic abnormalities requires precise acquisition of the mid‐sagittal plane (MSP). However, achieving an appropriate MSP is technically challenging due to anatomical variability and operator dependence inherent in conventional 2‐dimensional (2D) ultrasound.

pmc-13672894.title: Determinants of patient satisfaction 5 years after dual-mobility trapeziometacarpal joint implant arthroplasty
pmc-13672894.creator: Daniel B Herren, Kei H Mathis, Stephan Schindele, Miriam Marks
pmc-13672894.description: Introduction:The primary aim of this registry-based case series was to identify determinants of patient satisfaction 5 years after dual-mobility trapeziometacarpal joint (TMJ) implant arthroplasty. Secondary aims included the assessment of 5 year outcomes and implant survival.Methods:Patients who underwent primary implantation of a dual-mobility TMJ prosthesis were included.

pmc-13710417.title: Longitudinal developmental profiles in 4- to 5-year-old Dutch children: a latent profile analysis
pmc-13710417.creator: Selena J Rosinda, Pieter J Hoekstra, Mijna Hadders-Algra, Kirsten R Heineman, Annelies de Bildt
pmc-13710417.description: We aimed to gain knowledge on children’s development by distinguishing developmental profiles based on neurological and motor assessments in infancy, and motor and cognitive assessments at early school age. Profile characteristics and the associations between profiles and behavioural characteristics at early school age were also examined.
